result.page_note: The AHPRA public register search URL (https://www.ahpra.gov.au/Register_Search.aspx) consistently returns a 404 error (URL rejected by administrator). The link 'Search registered health practitioners' on the AHPRA homepage also points to the same non-functional page. The page was blocked by server-side errors before any CAPTCHA appeared, preventing the search for practitioners with surname 'Smith'.

The task cannot be completed because the HCPC register website (hcpc-uk.org) is blocked by a Cloudflare security verification challenge (bot detection). The page displays a 'Performing security verification' screen and prevents access to the search results for surname 'Smith' with profession 'Occupational therapist'. This is an objective blocking factor that prevents data extraction.
